title: ENEMIES MISS MORE AT LONG RANGE
why: His answer 8 a: enemies a little less accurate at long range. Every enemy round, from machines and pillagers alike, now spreads wider the farther away it is aimed: as before up to 350, then a little wider with distance, up to 1.8 times as wide from about 830 out. Close fights are exactly as before and your own guns are unchanged, so a long range duel favours the player who closes in or takes cover, while a close fight is as deadly as ever.
now: Enemy fire now spreads wider at long range, so distant shooters miss more; close fights are unchanged.
